bio.text: Tom Cotton is a U.S. Senator from Arkansas, chairs the Senate Intelligence Committee, and is Chairman of the Senate Republican Conference.
He grew up on his family's cattle farm in Yell County and graduated from Harvard and Harvard Law School.
He served nearly five years on active duty as a U.S. Army Infantry Officer, with tours in Iraq and Afghanistan.
Before the Senate he worked for McKinsey & Co. and served one term in the U.S. House of Representatives.
